2017-A1647-36.quote: The assessor shall make a determination within thirty days after receipt of such application of whether the applicant would qualify for an exemption pursuant to this section on the assessment roll if title had been in the name of the applicant on the taxable status date applicable to such assessment roll.
2017-A1647-36.note: "the assessor" of a municipal corporation ("a county, city, town, village or school district") is the locality (criterion 3: "a locality's assessor ... is the locality"); stored under the non-locality group "Assessors (local)".

2017-A1647-37.quote: the assessor shall enter the exempt amount, if any, on the tentative assessment roll and, within ten days after filing such roll, notify the applicant of the approval or denial of such exemption, the exempt amount, if any, and the applicant's right to review by the board of assessment review.
2017-A1647-37.note: "the assessor" of a municipal corporation ("a county, city, town, village or school district") is the locality (criterion 3: "a locality's assessor ... is the locality"); stored under the non-locality group "Assessors (local)".

2017-A1647-38.quote: the assessor shall petition the board of assessment review to correct the tentative or final assessment roll in the manner provided in title three of article five of this chapter
2017-A1647-38.note: "the assessor" of a municipal corporation ("a county, city, town, village or school district") is the locality (criterion 3: "a locality's assessor ... is the locality"); stored under the non-locality group "Assessors (local)".

2017-A1647-39.quote: the assessor shall petition the board of assessment review to correct the final assessment roll.
2017-A1647-39.note: "the assessor" of a municipal corporation ("a county, city, town, village or school district") is the locality (criterion 3: "a locality's assessor ... is the locality"); stored under the non-locality group "Assessors (local)".

2017-A1647-40.quote: the assessor shall immediately notify the municipal corporation which levied the tax or for which the taxes were levied of the amount of pro rata exemption credits for the year in which such transfer occurred.
2017-A1647-40.note: "the assessor" of a municipal corporation ("a county, city, town, village or school district") is the locality (criterion 3: "a locality's assessor ... is the locality"); stored under the non-locality group "Assessors (local)".

2017-A1647-41.quote: the assessor shall determine the pro rata tax exemption credit for such tax roll by multiplying the tax rate or tax rates for each municipal corporation which levied taxes or for which taxes were levied times the exempt amount and shall immediately notify such municipal corporation or corporations of the pro rata exemption credits for such tax roll.
2017-A1647-41.note: "the assessor" of a municipal corporation ("a county, city, town, village or school district") is the locality (criterion 3: "a locality's assessor ... is the locality"); stored under the non-locality group "Assessors (local)".

2017-A1647-42.quote: Such municipal corporation shall add such pro rata exemption credits for such property to any outstanding pro rata exemption amounts and proceed as provided in subparagraph (iv) of paragraph (a) of this subdivision.
